name: INTPK_ALIAS_ROWID_NULL_AUTOFILL
description: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (no AUTOINCREMENT) auto-assigns ascending rowids on NULL insert

name: INTPK_ALIAS_ROWID_EQUALS_PK
description: rowid alias: SELECT rowid and the INTEGER PRIMARY KEY column return identical values

name: INTPK_EXPLICIT_VALUE_USED
description: Explicit INTEGER PRIMARY KEY value is used as rowid

name: INTPK_NEXT_AUTO_ABOVE_EXPLICIT
description: After explicit larger ID, next auto-assigned rowid is one more than max

name: INTPK_ROWID_REUSE_AFTER_DELETE
description: Without AUTOINCREMENT, deleted rowids may be reused (max+1 of remaining)

name: INTPK_NULL_PK_AFTER_DELETE_ALL
description: After DELETE FROM (no AUTOINCREMENT), next rowid restarts at 1

name: AUTOINCREMENT_KEYWORD_CREATES_SEQUENCE
description: AUTOINCREMENT keyword causes sqlite_sequence row creation after first insert

name: AUTOINCREMENT_MONOTONIC_AFTER_DELETE
description: With AUTOINCREMENT, rowids are strictly monotonic; deleted IDs not reused

name: AUTOINCREMENT_PERSISTS_AFTER_DELETE_ALL
description: DELETE FROM does not reset the AUTOINCREMENT counter; next ID is max+1

name: AUTOINCREMENT_EXPLICIT_BUMPS_SEQ
description: Explicit larger ID with AUTOINCREMENT advances sqlite_sequence

name: AUTOINCREMENT_NULL_PK_AUTOFILL
description: INSERT NULL into AUTOINCREMENT PK auto-assigns and updates sqlite_sequence

name: LAST_INSERT_ROWID_BASIC
description: last_insert_rowid() returns the rowid of the most recent successful INSERT

name: CHANGES_AND_TOTAL_CHANGES
description: changes() returns last statement's row count; total_changes() accumulates

name: REPLACE_INTO_KEEPS_PK_RESETS_ROWID
description: REPLACE INTO with same PK keeps the PK value but creates a new row (rowid alias preserved)

name: INSERT_OR_REPLACE_OVERWRITES
description: INSERT OR REPLACE on conflicting PK overwrites the existing row

name: REPLACE_WITH_AUTOINCREMENT
description: REPLACE on AUTOINCREMENT table preserves sqlite_sequence max

name: NO_SQLITE_SEQUENCE_WITHOUT_AUTOINCREMENT
description: A table without AUTOINCREMENT does not create sqlite_sequence

name: SQLITE_SEQUENCE_VISIBLE_AFTER_INSERT
description: sqlite_sequence is visible via SELECT * after AUTOINCREMENT insert

name: AUTOINCREMENT_MAX_ROWID_FAIL
description: AUTOINCREMENT after max-int64 rowid fails with SQLITE_FULL

name: AUTOINCREMENT_WITHOUT_ROWID_REJECTED
description: AUTOINCREMENT is not allowed on WITHOUT ROWID tables
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, b TEXT) WITHOUT ROWID;
expected_stderr_contains: AUTOINCREMENT not allowed on WITHOUT ROWID tables

name: AUTOINCREMENT_COMPOSITE_PK_REJECTED
description: AUTOINCREMENT cannot appear on a composite PRIMARY KEY clause
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER, b TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(a,b) AUTOINCREMENT);

name: ROWID_COLUMN_AS_PK_INSERT
description: Using INSERT INTO ... (rowid, b) on a rowid-alias table assigns the PK column
